findings.issue: その (demonstrative 'that', modifying 旅館 in その旅館 'that inn') is glossed 'garden' — a confusion with the unrelated noun 園 (その, 'garden'). Teaches a false meaning for a core N5 determiner.
Same defect as the en gloss: その is the demonstrative 'that' (その旅館 = 'aquela pousada'), not 'jardim' (confusion with the noun 園/その).

お姉ちゃん explicitly means big/older sister and だもん adds the 'because/after all' whining justification (the sentence's grammar target). 'I'm your sister.' drops both, while pt correctly renders 'irmã mais velha' + 'ué'. The en should parallel jp and pt.
findings.suggested: I'm your big sister, after all.

findings.issue: Note labels し in しないで as the 連用形 of する, but ない attaches to the 未然形 (negative/irrealis stem し). The same construction in sent:tatoeba-1006974 is correctly labeled 'raiz negativa de する'. The en half of the note repeats the error.
findings.current: forma 連用形 de する, parte de しないで
findings.suggested: raiz negativa (未然形) de する, parte de しないで

findings.issue: 'fonte da provocação' reads in pt-BR as 'source of teasing/provocation' and contradicts expl_pt, which says 'A fonte da admiração é 彼女の日本語と英語力'. Same wording in tokens[6].role ('parte da fonte da provocação') should be fixed to match.
findings.current: fonte da provocação (marcada por には)
findings.suggested: fonte da admiração (marcada por には)

findings.issue: 'As for the salad' applies the topic-mirror device (reserved for は) to a direct object marked by を, misrepresenting the structure; the expl itself says 'The object サラダ is marked by を'.
findings.current: As for the salad, please do eat it.

findings.issue: 'Quanto à salada' applies the topic-mirror device (for は) to an object marked by を, contradicting expl_pt ('O objeto サラダ é marcado por を') and miscuing the structure the literal field exists to show.
findings.current: Quanto à salada, faça o favor de comê-la (honorífico).
findings.suggested: A salada, faça o favor de comer (honorífico).

findings.issue: 服に is locative ('on the clothes'), not a は topic; 'As for the clothes' misrepresents に as topic marking in the structural mirror, contradicting the expl ('に marks the place of adherence').
findings.current: As for the clothes, blood is stuck all over, you see.
findings.suggested: On the clothes, blood is stuck all over, you see.

findings.issue: 'Quanto à roupa' misrepresents locative 服に as a は topic in the structural mirror; expl_pt itself says に marca o lugar de aderência.
findings.current: Quanto à roupa, o sangue está grudado bem grudado, viu.
findings.suggested: Na roupa, o sangue está grudado bem grudado, viu.
